title: WAL commit-path bundle: buffer, cadence, flush, group commit, compression
configuration_cause: wal_buffers=512 (4MB) with wal_writer_delay=200ms and commit_delay=0 leaves commit-path syncs unbatched; wal_compression off inflates FPI WAL volume, sustaining wal_wait and 0.14ms sync latency.
mechanism: The wal_commit_path bundle targets commit-path sync frequency and queueing. Raising wal_buffers to 2048 (16MB) absorbs bursts so backends need not stall on WAL insertion. Lowering wal_writer_delay to 50ms and wal_writer_flush_after to 64 (512kB) makes the writer drain and flush smaller batches more often, smoothing fsync cadence. commit_delay=100us with commit_siblings=2 lets concurrent committers coalesce into one fsync when at least two are active. Enabling wal_compression shrinks full-page-image WAL, reducing bytes per sync. Together these cut wal_waiting_backends and per-commit sync cost, freeing terminal capacity for GetUserTweets.
query_effect: Fewer backends blocked on WALWrite/WALSync; GetUserTweets p95 and InsertTweet p95 should fall as commit stalls shrink.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase (0.5-2%) from reduced commit-path stalls; primary gain is lower wal_wait and sync latency.
expected_latency_effect: Lower WAL sync wait; InsertTweet p95 down; GetUserTweets p95 slightly down.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: 4x current 4MB to 16MB, within safe [512,2048]; absorbs commit bursts without backend WAL-insert stalls.
Reduce from 200ms to 50ms, within safe [20,500]; more frequent writer wake-ups drain WAL sooner.
Halve from 128 to 64 (512kB), within safe [0,1024]; smaller flush batches smooth fsync cadence.
100us group-commit window, within safe [0,1000]; small enough to avoid added latency while coalescing concurrent committers.
Lower from 5 to 2, within safe [0,20]; activates group commit when at least two committers are active, matching 5-terminal load.
Enable compression to shrink FPI WAL volume; wal_fpi_per_txn=1.4e-4 with 4.8 bytes/txn WAL, compression reduces bytes per sync.

predictions.rationale: Larger WAL buffer plus faster writer cadence and group commit reduce backends blocked on WAL.
Group commit and compression reduce sync frequency and bytes per sync.
Reduced commit-path stalls free terminal capacity for GetUserTweets.

alternatives.statement: If only wal_buffers matters, raising it alone would cut wal_wait without changing sync_average_ms.
If FPI volume dominates, wal_compression alone would cut wal_bytes_per_txn and sync latency.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves the entire WAL commit path at defaults (wal_buffers=512, delay=200ms, commit_delay=0, compression off) while wal_wait is a high-severity anomaly. This coherent bundle directly targets the diagnosed commit-path queueing.
